_notes.payload_base: file offset of the BL31 AArch64 reset vector; file_off = payload_addr + payload_base
_notes.patch_site: droppable NOTICE banner print 'bl 0x730c' in bl31_main (cold boot, once, result unused)
_notes.wrapper: 0x10624 is the plain arming routine (SPM unlock, PWR_RST_B for cores 1-7, RESETPWRON cleared, CPC_CTRL_ENABLE set). Do NOT point this at 0x9418, the routine the kernel boot SMC calls: on this firmware it does more than arming and the console no longer boots (tried, recovered with SP Flash Tool).
_notes.old_insn: the original 'bl 0x730c' at the patch site; the tool refuses to patch if the bytes differ
_notes.android: the firmware's one-shot flag is not set by this patch, so the kernel boot SMC still runs its full routine as on stock firmware
